package.name: l5_reactive_lap
package.description: L5 sim-in-loop lap canary for the reactive controllers (GitHub issue 26, claude-docs/12-testing.md): runs racer_gym_bridge with a walled corridor around the committed config/tracks/gym_oval raceline (track_half_width_m) and racer_control's gap_follow_node driving from the bridge's /scan only, and asserts the car completes laps within a time budget without leaving the corridor, in both lap directions with lane centring on. A second scenario runs a loop with one corner tighter than the turning circle, with safety_node in the loop, where the reverse escape must fire. Same shape as tests/l5_tracker_lap; a separate package so the tracker canary stays untouched. No library code of its own (l5_reactive_common.py is a test helper loaded by path).
